title: The community hall key
paragraphs: When Mei arrived at the community hall, she found {{1}} note taped to the glass door. The note said that the caretaker had left the spare key with Mr Sadiq, {{2}} ran the shop across the road.
Mei waited outside from nine o’clock {{3}} Mr Sadiq returned ten minutes later. He handed her the key, and she opened the hall before the other volunteers arrived.
